title: imap: STORE command handler (flag manipulation)
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/store.rs. STORE changes flags for a sequence set. Algorithm: (1) require Selected state; (2) reject if readonly (EXAMINE) -> tagged NO [CANNOT]; (3) resolve sequence set to CIDs; (4) for each CID: (a) get current flags from imap_flags; (b) apply StoreType: FLAGS (replace), +FLAGS (add), -FLAGS (remove); (c) update imap_flags table; (d) unless SILENT modifier: send * N FETCH (FLAGS (new_flag_list)); (5) tagged OK. Supported flags: Answered Flagged Deleted Seen Draft and user keywords (max 100, max 64 chars each). Defensive: unknown flag atom -> bad; SQL error -> tagged NO; readonly -> NO [CANNOT].
